Percent of vaccination visits with a missed opportunity

Source: R/mosv.R
estimate_mosv_visits.Rd

For each assessed dose, the share of documented visits at which the child was eligible for the dose but did not receive it (VCQI RI_QUAL_08), plus the share of visits with at least one MOSV for any dose and the mean number of MOSVs per visit. Unweighted; N counts visits.

estimate_mosv_visits(x, by = NULL, vaccines = NULL)

Arguments

x

A vcs_mosv object, or a vcs_data object (then derive_mosv() is called with vaccines).

by

Domains over the child-level columns.

vaccines

Doses; defaults to those in x.

Value

A tibble, one row per domain, with mosv_<dose> and n_<dose> columns for every dose, plus mosv_any, n_visits, mosv_per_visit.

Examples

estimate_mosv_visits(vcs_example)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 32
#>   domain   mosv_BCG n_BCG mosv_OPV0 n_OPV0 mosv_OPV1 n_OPV1 mosv_PENTA1 n_PENTA1
#>   <chr>       <dbl> <int>     <dbl>  <int>     <dbl>  <int>       <dbl>    <int>
#> 1 <overal…    0.829   526     0.906    658     0.799    169       0.736      318
#> # ℹ 23 more variables: mosv_PCV1 <dbl>, n_PCV1 <int>, mosv_OPV2 <dbl>,
#> #   n_OPV2 <int>, mosv_PENTA2 <dbl>, n_PENTA2 <int>, mosv_PCV2 <dbl>,
#> #   n_PCV2 <int>, mosv_OPV3 <dbl>, n_OPV3 <int>, mosv_PENTA3 <dbl>,
#> #   n_PENTA3 <int>, mosv_PCV3 <dbl>, n_PCV3 <int>, mosv_IPV1 <dbl>,
#> #   n_IPV1 <int>, mosv_MCV1 <dbl>, n_MCV1 <int>, mosv_YF <dbl>, n_YF <int>,
#> #   mosv_any <dbl>, mosv_per_visit <dbl>, n_visits <int>
